1121 Steam Basmati Rice tastes like no other rice on earth. Unlike ordinary long grain rice the light, fluffy texture of Basmati’s long, slender grains offers the palate a totally different experience in terms of mouth-feel and taste – distinctive, unique and slightly ‘nutty’

Cooking with 1121 Steamed Basmati Rice means you get light, delicate and separate grains.

That’s because we carefully mill our grains, rejecting broken grains that would otherwise release starch and cause the rice to become sticky. Uniquely, the Basmati grain expands more than twice its dry length during cooking. Unlike other types of rice the grains only expand length ways resulting in the grains retaining their long slender characteristic when cooked.
